content_blocks.label: clause_1._Personal_Property
content_blocks.text: I hereby bequeath my personal property to my beloved wife, Mary K. Hill, free and clear of all encumbrances.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Real_Property
content_blocks.text: I give and bequeath my real property located at 123 Maple Street, Pineville, to my daughter, Emily K. Hill, hereinafter referred to as 'the Beneficiary'.
